project.title: Hirana
project.description: These are Hirono-inspired stickers that I illustrated to celebrate every woman. It’s a collection of different hirono heads that have the styles of various women represented ech identyty in there hair styles and colors.. These stickers establish my passion for creating art with meaningful contribution and purpose.

project.title: phóteinos
project.description: A digital illustration that I drew when I felt all my dreams were aligning in my favor. Where light and burning passion meet, every swirl of light bursts through the dark, bluish abyss, revealing the deep enthusiasm and dreams I once imagined. This is one of my favorite digital artworks, as it encapsulates the thoughts that I had at that moment.

project.title: Mi casa
project.description: A screenplay that shows hidden thoughts, feelings, and regrets. The manuscript tells a story and conveys nostalgia, euphoria, and yearning. This screenplay holds a special place in my heart, and I hope that one day, this little story can be seen and appreciated by others.
